name: Scientific foundations of machine learning
description: A course-authored teaching graph connecting mathematical ideas, scientific models, and machine-learning methods.

concepts.label: Vector
concepts.description: An ordered collection that can represent a point, direction, state, or feature record.

concepts.label: Matrix
concepts.description: A rectangular array representing data, a linear map, or a system of equations.

concepts.label: Eigenvector
concepts.description: A nonzero direction whose span is preserved by a linear transformation.

concepts.label: Derivative
concepts.description: A local rate of change used to describe sensitivity and dynamics.

concepts.label: Gradient
concepts.description: The vector of partial derivatives of a scalar-valued multivariable function.

concepts.label: Differential equation
concepts.description: An equation relating an unknown function to one or more of its derivatives.

concepts.label: Probability distribution
concepts.description: A mathematical description of uncertainty over possible outcomes.

concepts.label: Expectation
concepts.description: A probability-weighted average of a random quantity.

concepts.label: Entropy
concepts.description: A quantity measuring uncertainty or dispersion in a probability distribution.

concepts.label: Bayes' rule
concepts.description: A rule for updating probabilities after observing evidence.

concepts.label: Markov chain
concepts.description: A stochastic process whose next-state distribution depends on its present state.

concepts.label: Optimization
concepts.description: The study of selecting variables to minimize or maximize an objective.

concepts.label: Linear regression
concepts.description: A model that relates predictors to a response through a linear combination.

concepts.label: Principal component analysis
concepts.description: A linear method that represents data along directions of greatest sample variance.

concepts.label: Neural network
concepts.description: A parameterized composition of functions used to learn representations or predictions.

concepts.label: Diffusion model
concepts.description: A generative model learned through a progressive noising and denoising process.

concepts.label: Epidemic model
concepts.description: A mathematical model of how an infectious process changes through a population.

concepts.label: Molecular dynamics
concepts.description: A computational method for simulating the motion of interacting atoms or molecules.

concepts.label: Scientific measurement
concepts.description: An observation produced by an instrument or experimental procedure with uncertainty.

concepts.label: Data matrix
concepts.description: A tabular numerical representation with observations and measured features.
